definitions: To turn into ice or another solid as a result of extreme cold.
To become covered or blocked with ice.
To damage or kill (a plant) with frost.
To stop moving or to make something stop moving.
To hold (assets or accounts) at a certain level or in a certain state, typically by official order.
To preserve (food) by refrigeration at below 0°C.
examples: The pipes might freeze if it gets any colder.
The sudden frost froze the young plants.
He froze when he saw the bear.
The government decided to freeze their assets.
I'm starting to freeze out here.
You can freeze most vegetables for later use.
